candidates.tagline: Co-op horror game ships key art that reads as 'Anus'
candidates.story: Engawa Games revealed the Steam key art for their co-op horror game 'In Us' with a stylized font where the 'I' and 'n' merge so tightly that the title reads unmistakably as 'Anus', earning it the unofficial 'Most Unfortunate Artwork of the Year' award.
candidates.why_funny: A serious, atmospheric horror game about exorcising demons accidentally made its own logo the demon.
candidates.alt: Four hooded bird-masked exorcist characters stand before a glowing stained-glass window, with the game's title logo 'In Us' appearing to spell 'Anus' due to tight kerning

candidates.tagline: Apple's macOS 27 wallpaper contains a building that cannot physically exist
candidates.story: Apple's default Golden Gate Bridge live wallpaper for macOS 27 has a VFX masking error where a brick-walled building overlaps a foreground rock in a physically impossible way, turning Apple's 'it just works' promise into an internet detective mystery.
candidates.why_funny: The company that prides itself on obsessive attention to detail shipped an OS wallpaper with a glitched building that defies the laws of physics.
candidates.alt: The Golden Gate Bridge under a vivid sunset sky, with a section near the foreground where a brick building edge impossibly overlaps a rock closer to the camera
